senses.gloss: चो॑द m. an implement for driving horses, goad or whip, v, 61, 3
चोद॑ (˚द॑), mfn. animating, inspiring, promoting, i, 143, 6; ii, 13, 9 and 30, 6 (cf. रध्रचोद॑.)
चोद , ˚दक, ˚दन, &c. See √ चुद्.
चोद॑—प्रवृद्ध (˚द॑-) mfn. exalted by the inspiring (draught of Soma), i, 174, 6.
चोदक mfn. impelling, MBh. xiii, 71
चोदक m. direction, invitation, KātyŚr. i, 10; Nyāyam. x
(in Gr.) = परि-ग्रह, q.v., RPrāt. x, 10
xi, 14
asker, objectioner, pupil, Jain.

चो॑दना f. reproof (as in Pāli), Divyāv. i, 54
चो॑दनी f. N. of a plant (v.l. for रोदनी), L., Sch.
चोदना-गुड m. a ball to play with, L.

चोदस् See अ-चोद॑स्.
चोदायनि m. pl. N. of a family, Pravar. iv, 8.

driven, impelled, incited, MBh.; R.

invited, directed, ordered, MBh.; Ragh. xii, 59
informed, apprised, W.
inquired after, BP. vii, 15, 13
enjoined, fixed, appointed, ŚāṅkhŚr.; KātyŚr.; Mn. ii f., viii; MBh. xiii, 2439; R. (B.) iii, 56, 16.

चो॑दिष्ठ mfn. most animating, viii, 100, 3.
चोद्य mfn. to be impelled or incited, MBh. v, 1404 and 4600
(अ- neg.), xiii, 4875
to be criticised, Sarvad. xiii, 111
to be thrown, W.

astonishment, wonder, Śiś. ix, 16.
